body.name: P^\star
body.construction: Take \(N_0=T_0=J=r=2\) and \[M=\begin{pmatrix}4/5&3/5\\3/5&3/10\end{pmatrix},\quad y=(7/10,9/20),\quad B=\begin{pmatrix}7/10&2/5\\1/2&1/5\end{pmatrix},\quad s_1=(7/10,2/5).\] The six marginal event-survival pairs \((S_c(t_{c1}),S_c(t_{c2}))\) are the target-pre pair \(y\), the two donor-pre rows of \(M\), the two donor-post rows of \(B\), and the target factual-post pair \(s_1\), respectively. Assign the latent untreated target-post row \(\theta=yM^{-1}B=(3/5,3/10)\). In every cell let \(X_{ci}\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\). For its displayed pair \((a,b)\), put \(\epsilon_x=2x-1\) and, conditional on \(X_{ci}=x\), assign \[P_c(T_{ci}=t_{c1}\mid X_{ci}=x)=1-a-\epsilon_x/20,\quad P_c(T_{ci}=t_{c2}\mid X_{ci}=x)=a-b+\epsilon_x/40,\quad P_c(T_{ci}=\infty\mid X_{ci}=x)=b+\epsilon_x/40.\] Set \((\gamma_{10},\gamma_{20})=(4/5,1/2)\) and \((\gamma_{11},\gamma_{21})=(3/5,2/5)\), and assign \[P_c(C_{ci}=t_{c1}\mid X_{ci}=x)=1-\gamma_{1x},\quad P_c(C_{ci}=t_{c2}\mid X_{ci}=x)=\gamma_{1x}-\gamma_{2x},\quad P_c(C_{ci}=\infty\mid X_{ci}=x)=\gamma_{2x}.\] Thus \((P_c(C_{ci}>t_{c1}\mid X_{ci}=x),P_c(C_{ci}>t_{c2}\mid X_{ci}=x))=(\gamma_{1x},\gamma_{2x})\). Draw \(T_{ci}\) and \(C_{ci}\) independently conditional on \(X_{ci}\), use \(\Delta_{ci}=\mathbf 1\{T_{ci}\le C_{ci}\}\), and take \(P^\star\) to be the product of these six cell laws.
